stem.text: Ethanal reacts with hydrogen cyanide in the presence of $\text{KCN}$ to produce a hydroxynitrile.
What is the first step in the mechanism of this reaction?

A.alt: Ethanal with delta+ on C and delta- on O; curly arrow from the C=O bond towards CN-.

B.alt: Ethanal with delta+ on C and delta- on O; curly arrow from the C=O bond to O, and a curly arrow from the lone pair on :CN- to C.

C.alt: Ethanal with delta+ on C and delta- on O; curly arrow from the C=O bond to O, and a curly arrow from the lone pair on CN- (drawn with two dots) to C.

D.alt: Ethanal with delta+ on C and delta- on O; curly arrow from the C=O bond to H+.
